title: Nonmalignant CNS tumor survival: RMST and relative survival analysis code
description: Statistical analysis source code for expected minus observed ten-year restricted mean survival time, internal age standardization, relative survival, age-specific and classification analyses, fixed-reference uncertainty checks, and diagnostic-confirmation sensitivity analyses. Includes source code and operating documentation only. No manuscript, data, individual records, results, session files or credentials are distributed. Authorized SEER inputs must be obtained independently.
